notes: Tail case, all units re-examined. U3 (removing the megaphone man) was physically coupled with U2 (his megaphone): retargeted to the orange DETOUR AHEAD sign (v2). U4 tiny background flag retargeted to the large US flag held up near the center (v2) with a verifiable payload. U1/U2 refs made specific; U2 payload made a real replacement.

difficulty.evidence_zh: 右前景白色手机、红帽男子的扩音器、橙色DETOUR AHEAD菱形标志和中间举起的大幅美国国旗是四个不同对象。
difficulty.specific_protection_zh: 保留人群、活动物品和现场环境。

spec.ref: the white smartphone held up in the right foreground

units.ref_zh: 右前景被举起的白色手机
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将右前景被举起的白色手机的颜色改为哑光黑色。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域的颜色改为哑光黑色。
units.reason: Another phone is raised by a man at the far right; 'right foreground' + white frame singles out the masked one (mask excludes the holding thumb).

spec.ref: the megaphone held by the man in the red cap

units.ref_zh: 戴红帽男子手持的扩音器
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将戴红帽男子手持的扩音器替换为一支黑色手持麦克风。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域替换为一支黑色手持麦克风。
units.reason: 'near the center' was vague; 'blue loudspeaker' was nearly the same object. A handheld microphone is a natural structural replacement.

spec.ref: the orange DETOUR AHEAD diamond sign in the background

units.ref_zh: 背景中橙色的DETOUR AHEAD菱形标志
units.instruction_ref_zh: 移除背景中橙色的DETOUR AHEAD菱形标志。
units.reason: Retarget: removing the megaphone man would leave U2's megaphone floating, and 'the person at the left' was ambiguous. The DETOUR AHEAD sign is unique; v2 mask via SAM3 text, verified.

spec.ref: the large US flag held up behind the man with the megaphone

units.ref_zh: 拿扩音器男子身后被举起的大幅美国国旗
units.instruction_ref_zh: 给拿扩音器男子身后被举起的大幅美国国旗加上一圈金色流苏。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 给选中区域加上一圈金色流苏。
units.reason: Retarget: the masked tiny background flag (29x56 px) was ambiguous with the large held flag, and a white emblem on a starred flag is hard to verify. The large held flag is unique; gold fringe is clearly verifiable. v2 mask excludes the megaphone.
